answer: Three options. (1) Upsert sink keyed by product and window start, so the replayed emission overwrites the earlier row and the latest wins. (2) Transactional sink that commits output in the same transaction as the checkpoint offsets, so post-checkpoint writes are never committed. (3) Dedupe on read: a view using ROW_NUMBER() partitioned by product_id and window_start, ordered by emitted_at DESC, keeping rn = 1. Prefer the upsert when the sink supports it, because the dedupe view adds a window function to every query. The orphaned pre-crash row stays in the table but is never read.
